identity.notes: Gated single-family sub-community of 33 units in Palm Beach Gardens, FL 33418, part of the larger Eastpointe Home Owners' Association. Residents have access to the Eastpointe Country Club, a private club featuring two Fazio-designed championship golf courses (36 holes total), resort-style pools, tennis, fitness, dining, and a year-round social calendar. The East Course (par-72, 7,011 yds) was refurbished in 2025; the West Course (par-70, 6,068 yds) is a Tom Fazio original. Club is Audubon-certified. Memberships available to both residents and non-residents.
